details.description: Gemini 2.5 Flash TTS is Google's fast, low-latency, cost-efficient text-to-speech model in the Gemini family, built for real-time voice assistants, high-volume narration, and conversational use cases that need fine-grained control over voice style and pacing, per its Gemini API model page. It converts text (up to 8,192 tokens) into audio (up to 16,384 tokens) and remains a preview model, last updated December 2025. Google's current Text-to-Speech guide no longer lists it in its supported-models comparison table, and Google's deprecations page recommends migrating to gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview.
advantages: Designed for low-latency, cost-efficient audio generation suited to real-time assistants, per its Gemini API model page.
Supports fine-grained control over voice style and pacing for narration and conversational use, per its Gemini API model page.
Supports Batch API processing for text-to-speech jobs, per its Gemini API model page.
disadvantages: Remains a preview model; Google's current Text-to-Speech guide no longer lists it in its supported-models comparison table.
Google's deprecations page recommends migrating to gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview, though no shutdown date has been announced.
Its Gemini API model page lists an 8,192-token input limit, smaller than Gemini's general-purpose chat models.
use_cases: Real-time voice assistants and conversational agents, per its Gemini API model page.
High-volume narration requiring fine-grained control over voice style and pacing, per its Gemini API model page.
Low-latency, cost-efficient speech generation, per its Gemini API model page.

notes: Catalog facts (8,192 input / 16,384 output tokens) match this model's own Gemini API model page exactly. Google's speech-generation guide's current 'Supported models' comparison table lists gemini-3.8-flash-tts, gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts, gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview and gemini-2.5-pro-preview-tts, but not this Flash model, and the deprecations page's Audio-models table gives it a release date of May 20, 2025 with recommended replacement gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview and no shutdown date announced. No supported-language list or benchmark figures were found on the pages opened.
